Introducing Dataiku Cobuild on Snowflake

May 20, 2026

3 min read

/

Patrick Phrayme

Table of Contents

From Shadow AI to Shadow Agents

The Hidden Cost of Autonomy

Why Traditional Governance Breaks Down

Visibility Is the Missing Primitive

Human-in-the-Loop as a Design Choice

The Real Shift: From Limiting AI to Seeing It

Companies are still searching for their “golden goose” data scientist.

Someone with a Ph.D. in math who can work with petabyte-scale data, train Kaggle Grandmaster-level machine learning (ML) models, build CI/CD pipelines to automate them, and roll their own open source development stack.
Our golden goose must be able to understand the business like a 30-year veteran, build compelling slides, and communicate highly technical solutions to non-technical executives. And, of course, our golden goose must usher in a company-wide AI transformation. We suddenly need 500 geese — and everything rests on their shoulders.

With
Dataiku Cobuild on Snowflake
, we're here to turn everyone into a golden goose.

If you’ve been following Dataiku, you know that this has been our goal from day one. Just last week (day 4,700ish), our
E2A (expert-to-agent) launch
put visual, inspectable AI in the hands of business experts. Now with Cobuild, we are extending that to anyone who can describe what they want to build.

Why Snowflake as our first launch partner? They share our goals to help enterprises build successful data, analytics, and AI solutions — and our view that success comes through building tools that break down technical barriers, empower others, and encourage collaboration.

What it does

Cobuild is an agent that helps build AI projects across analytics, data cleaning, ML, custom agent development, and more. A user describes what they want in plain language — "build a churn model on the last four quarters of account activity, weighted by contract size, and flag the top decile for outreach" — and Cobuild assembles the whole project as a visual, inspectable Dataiku workflow using our
E2A engine
.

Projects can include data preparation, joins, data quality checks, custom trained models, and charts to interpret model bias. Cobuild can help build agentic workflows with custom routing logic, or polished webapps that tap into the data, models, and agents it created previously.

The output isn't code (though it can be, if you ask it to). It's a visual Dataiku flow. Every node is inspectable. The analyst who asked the question can click through and see exactly which Snowflake dataset Cobuild pulled, how it was filtered, which features the model trained on, and what the performance looks like across different segments. They can edit any step. They can approve it. Nothing reaches production without sign-off.

When building enterprise data and AI applications, it’s crucial to follow data, transformations, models, and agents at each step. That's the distinction between enterprise building with Cobuild on Snowflake, and
vibe-coding
with traditional agentic coding tools. Other AI coding tools produce a wall of code that only a developer can audit. Cobuild produces a flow the person closest to the business problem can actually evaluate.

Built on Snowflake Cortex

When Cobuild runs on Snowflake, REST API calls to models (Claude, GPT) go through Cortex inside the customer's Snowflake account. For organizations that standardize on Snowflake, this means that data, conversations, and workload computation all stay in Snowflake. IT can rest easy knowing that their existing, Snowflake-centric governance model applies to every workload that Dataiku Cobuild generates.

Snowflake customers have invested in a foundation that's secure, governed, and ready for AI. Cortex brings the intelligence of leading foundation models into that same trusted environment. Now, Cobuild gives teams a conversational way to build with that intelligence, across more teams and more use cases, without ever leaving the Snowflake architecture.

What changes for teams already running both

More than 350 organizations run Dataiku on Snowflake today. For those teams, Cobuild expands who can contribute to AI development on top of their existing data foundation.

Work that's been kicked down the road three straight quarters moves forward. Work that needs our Ph.D. data scientist still goes to the data science team, with a shorter queue in front of it. And employees who understand the business better than anyone else now have a way to build custom data and AI applications inside a governed environment, where their work can be reviewed, reused, and operationalized — instead of spinning up separate, ungoverned tools.

For teams already running production workflows on Dataiku and Snowflake, development moves faster. Describe what needs to change in plain language — Cobuild does the rework against the same governed data, the same Cortex models, the same Dataiku project flow that's already running.

See it at Snowflake Summit

We'll be demoing Cobuild on Snowflake at the Dataiku booth (#2414) at Snowflake Summit, with sessions throughout the week. If your backlog of good ideas is longer than the team you have to build them, come find us.

Celebrating Data & AI Innovation: Dataiku Frontrunner Awards 2024

Oct 10, 2024

8 min read

/

Rachel Trenchard

As data, analytics, and AI continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible, 2024 has brought forward a new wave of groundbreaking use cases and innovative leaders. The
Dataiku Frontrunner Awards
honor these trailblazers — organizations and individuals who have harnessed Dataiku, the Universal AI Platform, to drive transformation across industries. This year’s winners and finalists exemplify how data-driven insights, AI advancements, and scalable strategies can unlock unprecedented business value and societal impact.

We are proud to announce the winners and finalists of the 2024 Dataiku Frontrunner Awards, showcasing a refreshed set of categories that focus on analytics modernization, Generative AI, and governance. These categories highlight the latest trends and achievements in AI, reflecting the evolving landscape of data and usage.

Watch the recording from the announcement on October 11, or read through for the winner and finalists!

Explore the Main Categories: Leading in Analytics and AI Innovation:

Best Analytics Modernization Use Case: Winners BCLC and Perdue Farms

Best Generative AI Use Case: Winners F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd. and Novartis Healthcare Private Limited

Best Governance Use Case: Winner Convex Insurance

Best MLOps Use Case: Winner FLOA

Best AI Democratization Program: Winner Prologis

Best Showcase of Return on AI (ROAI): Winner Zayo Group

Industry & Ecosystem Categories: Innovating Across Sectors
and
Founder's Vision Awards

Main Categories: Leading in Analytics and AI Innovation

Best Analytics Modernization Use Case

This category recognizes those spearheading analytics modernization by consolidating technologies and enhancing agility and decision-making through innovative frameworks.

Winner:

BCLC - Transforming Marketing Strategy: Optimizing ROI With In-House Marketing Mix Models and Dataiku

BCLC modernized its marketing analytics by adopting Dataiku to build internal Marketing Mix Models (MMM), optimizing their multimillion-dollar media spend and saving $1 million in consulting costs. This transformation allowed BCLC to reallocate budgets more effectively, enhance decision-making, and improve marketing efficiency across their retail and online channels.

Winner: Perdue Farms - Transforming Operations With Dataiku: From Manual Tasks to Data-Driven Insights

Perdue Farms addressed the inefficiencies of manual USDA data collection and reporting by implementing Dataiku to automate the entire process, from data ingestion to report generation. This automation has significantly reduced errors and time spent on data preparation, allowing the team to focus on analysis and insights. The streamlined workflow has empowered business users to generate reports faster and more accurately, enhancing decision-making and improving operational efficiency.

Finalist:

PASHA Holding - HR Data Transformation: Centralizing Insights for Improved Strategic Outcomes

Best Generative AI Use Case

As Generative AI takes center stage, this category celebrates those leveraging the Dataiku LLM Mesh, Prompt Studios, and other pre-built capabilities to deliver Generative AI applications.

Winner:

F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd. -
GenAI for Patent Attorneys to Identify and Analyze Relevant Case Law

By leveraging Dataiku’s Generative AI capabilities, including the Dataiku LLM Mesh, Prompt Studios, and Dataiku applications, Roche’s Group Patents team developed a cutting-edge chatWhitebook tool to streamline the preparation for patent opposition and appeal cases. The solution automates semantic searches and full text analysis across the library of 40,000+ European Patent Office case law references. This innovative use case showcases how citizen development and Dataiku’s tools can deliver powerful AI solutions, enabling faster, more informed decision-making in patent proceedings.

Winner:
Novartis Healthcare Private Limited - Revolutionizing Healthcare Market Research With the Dataiku LLM Mesh

Novartis’ Market Research team streamlined the analysis of healthcare professional interviews with the Dataiku LLM Mesh and Prompt Studios. By automating the processing of hundreds of transcripts, they accelerated insights gathering while maintaining a patient-first focus. This solution improved efficiency, democratized data access, and enhanced agility in responding to market changes.

Best Governance Use Case

Excellence in governance requires transparency and accountability. This category acknowledges organizations that have implemented robust frameworks for Responsible AI and data use.

Winner:

Convex Insurance - Building a Comprehensive Monitoring Solution: The Dataiku CoE Experience
Convex Insurance’s Dataiku Center of Excellence (CoE) transformed its governance framework by creating an incident management dashboard that provides real-time visibility into production health. This proactive approach has significantly reduced risks, improved operational efficiency, and fostered transparency, ensuring smooth and accountable project management across their data and AI initiatives.

Finalists:

Great Eastern Life Singapore - AI-Powered Transformation: Leveraging Dataiku for Scalable and Governed AI Models

Novartis Healthcare Private Limited - Transforming Data Workflows and Governance With Dataiku

Best MLOps Use Case

This category highlights organizations that have scaled their machine learning (ML) operations, streamlining model management and deployment at scale.

Winner:

FLOA - Streamlined Payment Solutions and Best Practices With Dataiku

FLOA has streamlined its ML operations by creating SOUL, an assistant tool integrated into Dataiku to ensure adherence to best practices in AI service development. This innovation has improved project monitoring, reduced risks, increased productivity by 25%, and enabled FLOA's data teams to efficiently manage over 200 projects and 50+ API services, enhancing operational reliability and scalability.

Finalists:

Standard Chartered Bank - Innovating Wealth & Retail Relationship Management: The Power of AI and Dataiku

Trellance - Predictive Analytics for Credit Union Next Best Product Offerings

Best AI Democratization Program

Democratizing AI is key to its broader adoption. This category honors programs that onboard large communities of professionals to expand data and AI use.

Winner:

Prologis - Scaling AI/ML Deployment and Democratizing Data Science: How Prologis Transformed Operations With Dataiku

Prologis has transformed its AI capabilities by implementing Dataiku, empowering a diverse range of users—from business analysts to data scientists—to build and deploy AI solutions without extensive coding skills. Making AI more accessible has expanded the number of active users, increased AI projects in use, and sped up the development of AI products, greatly improving time to market and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Finalists:

Johnson & Johnson (Vision) - Transforming Vision Care With GenAI: A Hackathon Powered by the Dataiku LLM Mesh

Toyota Motor Europe - Empowering Toyota with AI: Driving Innovation Through Hackathons and Hands-On Training

Best Showcase of Return on AI (ROAI)

Celebrating the organizations with the most impressive value stories, this category spotlights the largest ROI generated from AI initiatives.

Winner:

Zayo Group - Data-Driven Transformation for Operational Efficiency

Zayo transformed its Chief Data Office from a cost center to a profit center by leveraging Dataiku to deliver rapid, impactful data solutions. Through "data quick strikes," the team developed a churn prediction model and a revenue assurance initiative, realizing millions in savings and uncovering previously unrealized revenue. This approach showcased the substantial ROI of implementing data and AI initiatives at scale, optimizing operational efficiency across the organization.

Finalists:

OHRA - Simplifying Pet Insurance Claims for Better Efficiency and Satisfaction

Western Digital - Transforming NAND Die Screening: How Western Digital Uses Dataiku to Automate Outlier Detection

Industry & Ecosystem Categories: Innovating Across Sectors

Best Partner Acceleration Use Case

Collaboration often accelerates innovation. This category honors partnerships that have brought use cases to fruition faster and smarter.

Winner:

Operationalizing AI at Scale: How John Lewis Partnership Transformed MLOps With Dataiku and Deloitte
Deloitte partnere
Winner: BCLC - Transforming Marketing Strategy: Optimizing ROI With In-House Marketing Mix Models and Dataiku
d with John Lewis Partnership (JLP) to overcome operational challenges in their AI/ML journey by leveraging Dataiku to deploy 12 production-grade AI models. Through a comprehensive MLOps foundation and extensive training, Deloitte streamlined the deployment process, achieving an average time-to-value of just five weeks instead of months. This initiative not only generated tens of millions in financial benefits but also empowered JLP's data science team to manage and maintain AI solutions independently, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation across the organization.

Finalists:

Aviva - A Holistic View of Customer Experience Using Clickstream Data, Customer Feedback, and Log Events

The Airline Pilot Club - Transforming Pilot Training With AI: Streamlining EBT and CBTA Implementation Through Amelia and Dataiku

AI for Retail/CPG

Retail and CPG companies are harnessing AI to revolutionize customer experiences and optimize operations. This category celebrates these transformative efforts.

Winner:

Travis Perkins Plc: Uncovering Correlations to Improve Safety

Travis Perkins Plc is the U.K.’s largest distributor of building materials. As part of its commitment to keeping people safe and well, the Group has developed The Safety Beacon. This is a new technology solution that provides early warnings of heightened operational risk. It works by enabling early intervention and a de-escalation of risks to prevent incidents. By bringing together data and applied AI, it creates a score based risk dashboard which is based on a wealth of historical factors and will continue to develop as new risks emerge, and the business learns how to utilize this effectively.

AI for Healthcare & Life Sciences

Innovation in healthcare is critical. This category honors organizations that are developing new technologies or expanding their applications with data and AI.

Winner: Novo Nordisk Inc. - Enhancin

The PReDICT model and Advanced Analytics Dashboard allow Novo Nordisk to provide its stakeholders with valuable insights about Type 2 diabetes patient populations. Through cohort identification of Type 2 diabetes patients with substantial risk of developing comorbidities over a five-year span, the PReDICT model and Advanced Analytics Dashboard provide information to support healthcare professionals in creating tailored care strategies. This empowers Medical Science Liaisons to engage more effectively with healthcare professionals, informing these stakeholders around the importance of guidelines-based care and providing them enhanced insights on the patient population(s) they treat.

Finalists:

Alnylam - ML-Based Patient-to-Treatment Signal Engine

Novartis Healthcare Private Limited - Revolutionizing Healthcare Market Research With the Dataiku LLM Mesh

AI for Financial Services

The financial services industry continues to benefit from AI. This category highlights those using data to improve or accelerate processes.

Winner: Standard Chartered Bank - Innovating Wealth & Retail Relationship Management: The Power of AI and Dataiku

Standard Chartered Wealth & Retail Banking leverages Dataiku to build over 300 AI models annually, enhancing customer engagement and relationship management for its 12 million customers. This integration has streamlined model development and governance, enabling the bank to build more effective models while learning through the process, significantly reducing costs and fostering innovation. Dataiku's platform has supported the analytics team, allowing for a focus on delivering value to stakeholders and improving overall efficiency.

Finalists:

Security Bank Corporation - Revamping Time Deposit Models for Liquidity Risk Management

Banque Saudi Fransi - Harnessing Data for Personalized Loan Offers

AI for Manufacturing

Manufacturing companies are increasingly using AI to streamline processes and boost efficiency. This category celebrates their efforts.

Winner:

Sumitomo Rubber Industries -Optimizing Manufacturing with AI: Enhancing Efficiency, Accuracy, and Product Quality Using Dataiku

By integrating Dataiku into the Tire-manufacturing process, Sumitomo Rubber Industries transformed its operations, automating critical steps previously marred by inefficiencies and human error. This new system streamlined production, greatly improved product uniformity, and enabled real-time adjustments, significantly enhancing overall quality and productivity. Dataiku's capabilities have fostered a collaborative, data-driven culture, allowing teams to focus on strategic initiatives rather than manual data handling.

Finalist:

Deloitte - Accelerating Operational Efficiency: How Dataiku, Rolls Royce, and Deloitte Revolutionized Rolls-Royce's Data Science and Analysis

Most Impactful Ikig.AI Story

Data and AI can drive positive social change. This category honors those making a meaningful impact on the world through the Dataiku platform.

Winner:

myAgro - Boosting Agricultural Impact With Dataiku: Faster Processes and Real-Time Support for Farmers and Vendors

myAgro leveraged Dataiku to automate data processes and create real-time dashboards, leading to a 75% increase in vendor sales and improved monitoring of farmer training programs, with over 900,000 attendees. This transformation empowered staff across the organization to make faster, informed decisions, significantly enhancing their impact and scalability.

Finalist
:

The Ocean Cleanup - Leveraging Dataiku for Efficient Data Science and Plastic Pollution Solutions

Founder's Vision Awards

In addition to the predetermined categories, we are excited to announce the Founder’s Vision Distinctions as part of this year’s Dataiku Frontrunner Awards. These special recognitions celebrate exceptional achievements that caught the attention of Dataiku's CEO and co-founder, Florian Douetteau, highlighting innovative and transformative uses of AI beyond the pre-established categories.

Founder's Vision Award for Platform Scalability

Recognizes an organization’s transformation of their data science infrastructure, as they replaced their previously complex and costly setup with a streamlined Dataiku platform.

Awarded to: Aviva - Optimizing Dataiku for Enhanced Scalability and Efficiency

Founder's Vision Award for Build Over Buy

Celebrates a team's initiative to enhance operational performance by developing a custom solution within Dataiku, replacing a traditional off-the-shelf product. This award recognizes the team's efforts in leveraging Dataiku's capabilities to create a tailored solution that meets specific organizational needs more effectively.

Awarded to: BMO Financial Group - Automatic Tag Classification for Large Databases

Founder's Vision Award for AI-Powered Efficiency

Recognizes innovative solutions that enhance operational processes through automation and data integration, empowering organizations to improve accuracy, streamline workflows, and foster a data-driven culture for informed decision-making.

Awarded to
:

Novartis Healthcare Private Limited - Automating Treatment Centre Data Processing and Enhancing Operational Efficiency

Founder's Vision Award for Self-Service Analytics

Recognizes an organization for utilizing Dataiku to empower teams to independently analyze real-time data, successfully identify the root cause of operational issues, and implement optimized practices to improve overall efficiency.

Awarded to
:
Rio Tinto - Identifying Root Causes of Aluminium Casting Aborts

Founder's Vision Award for AI for Science

Recognizes innovative applications of AI technology that enhance scientific research and operational efficiency.

Awarded to
:

ALMA - Streamlining QA0 Processes for Enhanced Telescope Operations

Founder's Vision Award for AI for Safety

Given to an organization that uses innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to enhance operational efficiency and decision-making processes, ensuring safety and compliance in critical services by optimizing workforce management and improving overall job satisfaction for employees.

Awarded to: Enhancing Survey Operations at ABS: A Data-Driven Staffing Approach - American Bureau of Shipping

Founder's Vision Award for Dataiku for Education

Honors initiatives that enhance educational outcomes by integrating advanced analytics and data science tools into curricula, empowering diverse student bodies to acquire essential skills for success in an increasingly data-driven world.

Awarded to
:
Dayananda Sagar University - Empowering Future Business Leaders With Data-Driven Skills: Integrating Dataiku Into SCMS Curriculum

As we celebrate the winners and finalists, we are inspired by the immense creativity, innovation, and value they have brought to their organizations and industries. Stay tuned as we dive deeper into each of these stories in the coming weeks, shining a spotlight on the remarkable achievements that are shaping the future of analytics and AI.

Unlocking Dataiku’s Hidden Gems for Data Preparation

Sep 10, 2024

2 min read

/

Lauren Anderson

For many data professionals, spreadsheets have long been the go-to tool for data preparation.
A recent survey
of 200 senior analytics and IT leaders reveals that nearly 25% of teams still rely on spreadsheets as their primary tool for data manipulation in 2024. Their flexibility and familiarity make them a staple in countless workflows.

However, as data volumes grow and the complexity of analyses increases, spreadsheet-based processes can become
cumbersome and error-prone
. Common challenges include managing large datasets, handling complex formulas, and ensuring data consistency across multiple sheets. Additionally, the lack of version control, difficult collaboration, and the lack of advanced data preparation features can limit productivity and lead to inefficiencies.

Enter
Dataiku
, the solution for a more scalable, efficient, and powerful approach to data preparation. While Dataiku is known as the Universal AI Platform, it also provides a suite of features specifically designed to address the pain points faced by spreadsheet users. These features not only replicate the familiar functionalities of spreadsheets but also enhance them with advanced capabilities that are particularly useful for handling larger datasets and more complex data preparation tasks.

Dataiku allows users to work with data in ways that are intuitive for those who are accustomed to spreadsheets, while also offering tools that take data preparation to the next level. In this post, we’ll explore a few of Dataiku’s newest features that users might not be aware of. Whether you’re new to Dataiku or looking to unlock more of its potential, these features can help you overcome the limitations of traditional spreadsheet tools and elevate your data preparation game.

Multi-Row Formulas

In spreadsheets, users sometimes rely on complex formulas that reference multiple rows to derive insights or clean data. Dataiku brings this familiar concept into a more advanced environment, allowing users to create
multi-row formulas
that can perform operations across rows of data. Whether you need to calculate running totals or perform other types of iterative calculations, multi-row formulas offer a powerful and efficient way to manipulate data.

Quickly create offset arguments for iterative calculations.

Conditional Logic

Another valuable feature is the
If/Then/Else logic
. This conditional logic is a staple in spreadsheet-based data preparation, used to categorize or filter data based on specific conditions. Dataiku enhances this capability by allowing users to build complex conditional workflows without needing to write code. This feature is especially useful for those who need to segment data, create custom categories, or apply filters dynamically based on changing conditions.

Easily apply conditional logic in Dataiku.

Automated Transformations With Generative AI

AI Prepare
is one of Dataiku’s more advanced and lesser-known tools that can significantly simplify data preparation tasks. For users familiar with automated data preparation tools in other platforms, AI Prepare takes this concept to the next level by combining the power of the Dataiku prepare recipe with Generative AI.

With just a few simple instructions, Dataiku automatically recommends and maps out the necessary steps needed for your data transformation. This is particularly helpful if you have a general idea of what you need to do, but aren’t completely sure how to accomplish your task.

Simply write out what you want — Dataiku does the rest.

Preview Data Transformations

Finally, the ability to
preview data before applying transformations
is a game-changer for those who are used to working with data preparation tools that lack this feature. In Dataiku, users can see the immediate impact of their transformations before committing to them within the prepare recipe, reducing the risk of errors and making it easier to experiment with different approaches. This real-time feedback loop is invaluable for ensuring accurate data preparation on the first try, saving both time and effort in the long run.

Preview steps in the prepare recipe before applying them to data.

These are just a handful of features that help users make data preparation up to 10x faster. From easily connecting data sources with built-in connectors, to speeding up transformations with hundreds of visual recipes, Dataiku is designed to take
data preparation
to the next level. We’ll talk about some of our other great data preparation features you may not know about in upcoming blogs, so keep an eye out for more!

Dataiku Is a Gartner Peer Insights Customers’ Choice

Dec 13, 2024

2 min read

/

Catie Grasso

More than 700 companies around the world are getting concrete value from Dataiku. With Dataiku, the Universal AI Platform, they are uniting their teams, data, technology, and governance in one central place to not only survive — but thrive — in the era of Generative AI.

Today, our gratitude for our diverse customer base takes on a whole new level of meaning.

We’re excited to announce that

Table of Contents

Today, we’re proud to announce that we’ve been named a Leader for the fourth year in the 2025 Gartner™ Magic Quadrant™ for Data Science and Machine Learning Platforms. Dataiku was recognized for “Completeness of Vision” and “Ability to Execute.”

Dataiku Is a Leader for the 4th Time & The Universal AI Platform™

We believe Dataiku continues to lead with both foresight and execution. Our architecture was designed to meet enterprise needs
before
the market demanded it — offering a scalable, secure, and interoperable platform that lets businesses create, connect, and control their AI with confidence.

"During a time when the only constant in the AI market is change, we’ve focused not just on keeping up with the market, but in shaping it — building an enduring foundation that gives our enterprise customers governed, trusted control of AI’s raw power. We believe our position reflects the depth and breadth of our platform, the strength and vision of our global team, and the trust our customers place in our ability to help them turn AI into a differentiated business advantage."

Florian Douetteau, co-founder and CEO of Dataiku

That foundation has powered real results (take a sneak peek of some of those tangible results
here
from companies like
Johnson&Johnson
,

,

,

,

,
Prologis
,
Standard Chartered Bank
, and more). From early experimentation to enterprise-wide scale, Dataiku delivers — pairing powerful capabilities with hands-on support, proven reliability, and a people-first approach that resonates across industries.

Analytics, Models, & Agents for Maximum Flexibility

Dataiku gives enterprises the freedom to innovate without friction. We integrate with your tech stack to de-risk the adoption of new technologies, such as LLMs, while optimizing costs and managing risks associated with your legacy systems.

Unlike platforms that tie innovation to proprietary stacks, Dataiku is deeply integrated yet entirely vendor-agnostic. Organizations can connect to any infrastructure, model provider, or AI service — giving you full control of your strategy as technology continues to evolve.

A core part of that innovation engine is the
Dataiku LLM Mesh
— our secure, scalable, and agnostic architecture for generative and agentic AI. Rather than simply embedding LLMs, Dataiku built a comprehensive framework that allows teams to manage, route, and govern LLMs at scale.

The LLM Mesh serves as a unified gateway to thousands of models — from top-tier providers to open-source and self-hosted options. And with
Dataiku LLM Guard Services
, teams can monitor usage, enforce budget limits, evaluate performance, and ensure responsible model and agent behavior over time.

The Only Platform for the Future of Enterprise AI

We believe that what sets Dataiku apart isn’t just the tech — it’s our people-first approach to AI. Built for everyone from data scientists to business users, the platform makes AI accessible, collaborative, and easy to govern.

As AI evolves, enterprises need more than point solutions. They need flexibility, control, and the confidence to scale responsibly. That’s what Dataiku delivers: a single platform to power what’s now and build what’s next.

The Real Shift: From Limiting AI to Seeing It

At Dataiku, we believe that the true power of AI is unlocked not just through technology, but through the expertise and commitment of the people who deploy it. In an era where "AI-ready" is the minimum requirement, the differentiator is the human intelligence behind the machine.

That's why we launched the 2025 Global Partner Certification Challenge: a global initiative designed to recognize and accelerate the partners who are setting the standard for scalable, production-ready AI.

At a time when organizations are moving from AI experimentation to real business impact, certified expertise has never mattered more — for partners, and for the customers counting on them. When a partner invests in certification, customers get faster deployments, fewer missteps, and teams who speak the language of their business. This challenge highlights the partners who are leading that shift — and helping customers turn AI ambition into measurable outcomes.

To bridge the gap in technical depth across our ecosystem, a 12-week intensive sprint was designed to level up our partners, push the boundaries of their technical proficiency, and reward those who go the distance to achieve mastery. The challenge combined structured learning through Dataiku Academy with hands-on certification tracks focused on building and deploying AI on Dataiku — the Platform for AI Success — including
machine learning
,
MLOps
, and
GenAI
use cases.

A sprint to excellence

The Global Partner Certification Challenge wasn't just about passing exams, it was about building a culture of continuous learning. Over 12 weeks, our partners dedicated hundreds of hours to mastering the nuances of
Dataiku, the Platform for AI Success
.

This commitment ensures that when a customer engages with a Dataiku partner, they aren't just getting a service provider — they are getting a team of experts equipped with the latest best practices in AI, analytics, and governed deployment.

Meet our 2025 Partner Certification Challenge winners

The 2025 Global Partner Certification Challenge saw incredible participation, but a few organizations truly set the gold standard. These partners didn't just meet the requirements; they integrated Dataiku expertise into the very DNA of their service delivery.

Persistent Systems

Persistent Systems
has demonstrated a strong commitment to scaling enterprise AI through its continued investment in Dataiku certifications and production-grade delivery capabilities. This momentum reflects Persistent’s focus on turning AI strategy into measurable business outcomes for global clients.

Through its Dataiku-certified teams, Persistent delivers governed, production-ready AI at scale, implementing CI/CD pipelines, MLOps accelerators, and multi-cloud workflows to accelerate time-to-market across financial services, life sciences, and retail.

“Our AI strategy is built on pillars of hyper-productivity, enterprise data readiness, and responsible AI adoption. Dataiku aligns perfectly with these principles by accelerating AI engineering, enabling industry-specific workflows, and embedding governance for trusted scaling.

Together, we can co-deliver transformative, scalable AI solutions that drive measurable business impact for our clients.“

Brij Gupta, SVP & Global Head, Partnerships, Persistent Systems Limited

Wipro

Wipro weaves AI strategy and human ingenuity into the enterprise fabric. By cultivating an AI-ready workforce, Wipro empowers clients to scale intelligence and maintain a dominant competitive edge.

Global delivery:
Certified teams deploying enterprise-scale AI across BFSI, manufacturing, and energy, driving faster insights and measurable ROI.

In-house innovation:
Through Dataiku Lab, Wipro built proprietary accelerators for legacy migration, GenAI-powered apps, and Agent Observability.

Efficiency at scale:
These tools significantly reduce manual intervention, streamlining the transition to self-serve, modern analytics environments.

“Achieving a Top 4 position in the Dataiku Partner Certification Challenge demonstrates Wipro’s unwavering commitment to excellence, innovation, and advanced expertise in data science and AI.

As we accelerate AI-driven outcomes to deliver transformative value for our clients, we remain focused on co-innovation and collaboration with Dataiku through Wipro Innovation Network, part of Wipro Intelligence to lead in an intelligence-driven era.“

Srinivasaa HG, SVP & Global Head of Data, Analytics & AI, Wipro

FPT Software

FPT Software
has made a deliberate, large-scale investment in Dataiku certifications to support its AI-first delivery model and accelerate enterprise AI adoption globally.

“As an AI-first organization, we invested early and systematically in building deep Dataiku expertise across our teams, earning more than 3,400 Dataiku certifications to date.

This capability strengthens our ability to deploy governed, scalable AI solutions that optimize operations and unlock new revenue streams for our clients. It reflects our focus on turning AI investment into tangible, enterprise-level impact.“

Dao Duy Cuong, Executive Vice President & Chief Digital and Technology Officer, FPT Corporation

This investment has strengthened FPT’s AI-first delivery model, enabling faster transitions from proof of concept to production, expanding end-to-end capabilities across advanced analytics, machine learning, MLOps, and responsible AI governance, and ensuring consistent execution of production-grade AI solutions at scale.

AVISIA

AVISIA has established itself as a premier consultant in AI and data-driven business transformation. In an era of rapid technological acceleration, AVISIA bridges the gap between high-level strategic vision and technical IT deployment, turning raw data into a measurable performance driver.

With a powerhouse team of 300 experts, AVISIA designs and deploys bespoke projects tailored to generate maximum ROI. By covering the entire value chain, we ensure that AI initiatives aren't just technical experiments - they are core contributors to business success.

Since 2014, our long-standing partnership with Dataiku has been a cornerstone of our service offering. We believe that a consultant's value is only as strong as their technical mastery. To maintain our edge, we prioritize:

Continuous upskilling: Rigorous development programs to ensure our consultants remain at the forefront of the Dataiku ecosystem.

Strategic collaboration: Working closely with market leaders to deliver the most advanced data solutions available.

Operational excellence: Moving projects seamlessly from executive committee vision to full-scale operational reality.

Orange Business

By prioritizing Dataiku certifications, Orange Business has significantly strengthened its technical core, enabling the delivery of complex, AI-driven initiatives.This commitment to expertise has led to the successful deployment of Dataiku solutions for prominent global leaders across the pharmaceutical, energy, and financial sectors.

The result:

Accelerated use cases: Rapidly moving from pilot to production.

Expanded portfolio: Delivering a broader range of sophisticated AI projects.

Market leadership: Solidifying Orange’s position as a key orchestrator in the global AI ecosystem.

“Our team prioritized these certifications to deepen our expertise in data science and AI, enabling us to better support our clients’ digital transformation journeys.

This investment expands our ability to deliver innovative, high-value solutions and reinforces our role as a trusted data partner.”

Kaouthar Rahmani, Orange Business

Dataiku Ranked #1 in Product Owner Use Case in Gartner Critical Capabilities Report

Jul 10, 2025

3 min read

/

Catie Grasso

Table of Contents

While we’re proud to be a Leader in the
2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Data Science and Machine Learning Platforms
for the fourth time, the recognition doesn’t stop there. Dataiku is also recognized in the 2025 Gartner Critical Capabilities for Data Science and Machine Learning Platforms, Core Data Science report, ranking #1 for the Product Owner Use Case.

This year’s Critical Capabilities report reflects continued evolution of the data science and ML space. With updated evaluation criteria, including dedicated Use Cases for Product Owners, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and Model Validators, this report offers a clear lens for understanding how well vendors align with specific enterprise roles and responsibilities.

And when it comes to enabling product owners to steer AI strategy with impact and governance? Dataiku leads the pack.

What's New in This Year's Evaluation?

Unlike previous editions, the 2025 report places a sharper focus on role-based value delivery. Gartner defines the Product Owner Use Case as the “use of the DSML platform to prioritize and oversee the development process to align with business goals and user needs.” In other words, it’s a test of how well a platform empowers those responsible for managing data initiatives, aligning teams, and delivering business outcomes — not just building models.

Key evaluation criteria for this use case included:

Project and Value Management (30%): The capability to scope, define and measure projects by defining business outcomes and success criteria.

Governance and Risk Management (20%): The capability to create, enforce and measure compliance against governance controls and reduce risk.

We believe Dataiku’s #1 placement here reflects our strong foundation in both of these areas. As The Universal AI Platform™, we empower product owners to orchestrate complex initiatives across the data lifecycle while also delivering transparency, auditability, and control.

Why We Believe Dataiku Received This Ranking

Here’s why we believe Dataiku ranked highest for this critical role:

✅

Governance and Oversight From the Ground Up

From role-based access controls to automated documentation and lineage tracking, Dataiku provides a governance-first foundation that enables confidence at scale. Built-in features like governance dashboards, approval workflows, and project-level auditability ensure product owners always have a pulse on project health and risk exposure.

✅
Transparent, Traceable, and Trustworthy AI

Product owners don’t just need results — they need to know how those results were achieved. Dataiku’s commitment to explainability, bias detection, and model risk management enables organizations to meet internal and external requirements for trust and transparency.

✅
Alignment With Business Value

With Dataiku, project managers can define success criteria, assign business goals to projects, and continuously monitor value delivery, all in one platform. Whether you’re tracking model adoption or quantifying impact through integrated metrics, Dataiku connects technical progress with business ROI.

✅
Collaboration Without Chaos

Dataiku’s visual tools and no-code features enable product owners to stay engaged throughout the lifecycle — no Python required. At the same time, coders and engineers can go deep with code and integrate with Git, CI/CD, and MLOps tools. This flexibility helps teams stay aligned without compromising on depth or speed.

Recognized Across the Board

Check out the scores Dataiku received across all Use Cases:

3.68/5 in the Product Owner Use Case (Dataiku ranked first out of 16 vendors)

3.62/5 in the Model Validator Use Case (Dataiku ranked top three out of 16 vendors)

3.76/5 in the Data Analyst Use Case (Dataiku ranked top three out of 16 vendors)

3.51/5 in the Data Scientist Use Case (Dataiku ranked top five out of 16 vendors)

We believe this recognition reinforces the breadth and depth of Dataiku across all types of users in the enterprise, both as individuals and together.

Build Trustworthy AI, Together

As roles like product owners, analysts, and model validators take center stage in shaping enterprise AI, platforms must meet each of them where they are — and help them work together to deliver impact, responsibly and at scale.

That’s exactly what the Gartner Critical Capabilities report is designed to help you do:

✔️ Identify the right capabilities for your team’s needs

Dataiku Solutions: How They Work and How to Use Them

Dec 18, 2024

3 min read

/

Lauren Anderson

Most of the time, business teams have a good idea of what they want to achieve when implementing AI use cases. However, when it comes to getting started they often face roadblocks. These projects often require specialized skills and a strong understanding of industry best practices.

Without this expertise, data initiatives can stall or require extensive resources and time. This is where
Dataiku Solutions
can help! Designed to accelerate the deployment of AI and empower a wider range of users, these pre-packaged use cases help diverse teams leverage AI at scale, whether they are data scientists looking to speed up projects, data leaders looking to get more ROI out of data initiatives, or business teams that are struggling to achieve what they want when it comes to AI.

By packaging AI use cases in a flexible, easy-to-deploy format, Dataiku Solutions make AI accessible to more organizations. This article explores what Dataiku Solutions are, how they work, and why they’re essential to fostering a truly inclusive AI journey in any organization.

What Are Dataiku Solutions?

Dataiku Solutions are ready-to-use projects that address specific business needs or industry use cases, such as customer segmentation, financial forecasting, or maintenance planning. Each solution is designed to speed up the deployment of these use cases by providing end-to-end workflows, data pipelines, predictive models or large language model (LLM) calls, and visualizations tailored for actual business decision-making. These solutions not only allow teams to save time but also provide best practices for implementation, ensuring that even complex data initiatives can be executed with ease.

[Dataiku Solutions] allowed us to accelerate topics that simply could not fit into our busy roadmap. The implementation only took a few hours, and we are now ready to launch a marketing campaign powered by the Market Basket Analysis solution.

-
Ben Powis, Head of Data Science at MandM

Dataiku Solutions are fully customizable, meaning users can adapt them to fit their own data, add or remove features, and tailor them to meet unique business requirements. By packaging advanced analytics capabilities into a ready-to-use format, Dataiku Solutions empower teams to tackle data challenges without needing to build everything from scratch, helping both beginners and seasoned analysts focus on insights instead of infrastructure.

How Do Dataiku Solutions Work?

Dataiku Solutions provide a structured framework that guides users through the entire process of data preparation, modeling, and business decision. Here’s an overview of the components and workflow:

Data Pipeline
: Each solution includes a data pipeline that is pre-configured to prepare, clean, and transform raw data into a format suitable for analysis. The pipeline leverages Dataiku’s robust recipes to handle diverse data requirements. Projects contain sample data that can then be fully customized with your teams' data.

Predictive and Generative Models
: Dataiku Solutions come with configurable machine learning (ML) models or integration of LLMs that align with specific business objectives and can be adjusted based on your business data.

Dashboards and Reporting
: Each solution typically includes pre-built dashboards, reporting templates and, in some cases, interactive applications, making it easy to share results with stakeholders. Visualizations, summaries, and customizable reports allow teams to communicate insights effectively, fostering data-driven decision-making across the organization.

How to Use Dataiku Solutions

Using Dataiku Solutions is straightforward, and they are designed to accommodate users with varying levels of data expertise. Here’s a step-by-step guide to get started:

Select a Solution
: Browse Dataiku’s Solution catalog, which categorizes solutions by industry and business function. Choose a solution that aligns with your objectives and review its requirements to ensure it matches your data sources and analytics goals.

Easily select the Dataiku Solution for your use case.

2. Install and Configure
: Regardless of the solution you choose, it can be installed directly into your Dataiku environment with just a few clicks. You can easily get in touch with your admin for any package or plugin addition to your instance. Once installed, you’ll have access to a project, complete with pre-built data pipelines, models, and dashboards. Start by exploring to see what adjustments would be needed.

3. Data Preparation and Exploration
: Import your data into the solution and follow the guidance provided in the documentation. Dataiku’s interactive tools allow you to explore and clean data, and you can make adjustments to the pre-configured pipeline if necessary to better suit your data.

4. Model Training and Tuning
: Use the solution’s pre-built ML models or modify them to better fit your use case. In the case of GenAI embedded solutions, adjust the approach to your choice of LLM and refine prompts. Dataiku offers various options for model tuning and validation, allowing users to refine models based on their data.

5. Deploy and Monitor
: Once satisfied with the project performance, deploy it to a production environment. Dataiku’s monitoring capabilities allow you to track the project's quality over time, ensuring it continues to deliver reliable results. Additionally, you can configure alerts or retraining schedules to keep the model up-to-date as data changes.

6. Share Insights
: Use the solution’s dashboards and reporting features to share findings with stakeholders. Dataiku makes it easy to create visually engaging reports, which can be customized and shared directly within the platform or exported as needed.

Why Choose Dataiku Solutions?

Dataiku Solutions are more than just templates. They’re accelerators that help organizations overcome common data challenges with minimal setup. By providing pre-configured workflows and models, Dataiku Solutions reduce the time and resources needed to achieve data-driven results. For data experts, solutions offer a foundation that can be expanded and customized, while for business users, they deliver accessible, actionable insights that drive decision-making.

Dataiku Solutions empower teams to leverage data efficiently, whether they’re predicting trends, optimizing processes, or personalizing customer experiences. With Dataiku, your organization can tackle data challenges with confidence, transforming insights into tangible business value.

Dataiku Stories: Dynamic Presentations for Data-Driven Decisions

Dec 10, 2024

4 min read

/

Lauren Anderson

We’ve all been there: It’s late in the afternoon, and you suddenly get a message from leadership asking for a presentation on the latest sales forecast — due in an hour. You scramble, pulling data from multiple tools, pasting outdated screenshots into slides, and hoping the insights still hold true by the time it’s delivered.

What if, instead of the chaos just described, you could instantly generate a polished, data-driven presentation that’s always up-to-date? Enter
Dataiku Stories
, a groundbreaking new feature in Dataiku that lets analytics teams create dynamic, trustworthy presentations in seconds, all powered by
Generative AI
and the most current data.

The Challenge: Static Presentations and Outdated Insights

For most data teams, presentations are the primary medium through which insights reach the broader business. However, these traditional presentations have major pitfalls.

First, they’re static: As soon as they’re sent, they become out of date, especially in organizations where data is constantly changing. Screenshots pasted into decks from various tools can result in inconsistencies, leaving decision-makers with outdated, incomplete, or inaccurate information. This leads to a second problem: trust. If the data in your slides can’t be fully trusted or easily traced to its source, how can the business be confident in its decisions?

And third, these presentations are time-consuming to produce. Analysts are often tasked with creating visualizations and slides manually, sifting through tools, aggregating data, and cleaning it up just to make it presentable — only for it to lose relevance in a matter of days.

Seamless, Trusted, and Dynamic Presentations

Dataiku Stories takes the pain out of creating data-driven presentations. Rather than spending hours building reports or dashboards, analysts and data teams can now create dynamic stories in seconds. Leveraging Generative AI, Dataiku Stories automatically suggests the right data points, highlights key insights, and even helps format and design the presentation — turning a time-consuming process into a swift and efficient one. And most importantly, the insights are always up to date, coming directly from trusted datasets within the
Dataiku platform
.

For data executives and analytics leaders, Dataiku Stories offers something invaluable: peace of mind. Presentations can be built using trusted analytics and maintained within the Universal AI Platform. With a single platform for both data preparation and storytelling, Dataiku Stories ensures your presentations are grounded in accurate, up-to-date data, boosting trust in the insights shared across the business.

Why Dataiku Stories Stands Out: Bridging the Collaboration Gap

Today, a gap exists between data products that data teams create and tools, such as presentations or dashboards, that are used to share last-mile insights to business stakeholders so that they can make data-driven decisions. This means that while business teams are actually using their work, data teams miss out on the opportunity to receive valuable feedback that could be reincorporated for better results in upstream projects.

Dataiku Stories was designed to help bridge that gap. By unifying presentation development into the same platform where data teams build analytics projects and AI models, business teams can take trusted data that is shared with them and create polished presentations without needing to hop between different tools.

The result? More productivity, greater trust, and a seamless handoff between data teams and business stakeholders.

Let’s explore some of the standout features that make Dataiku Stories an essential tool for data and analytics teams:

1. Generative AI Assistant
: The GenAI Assistant provides suggestions for relevant data points, layout ideas, and automatically generates content. This helps users quickly create compelling presentations and ensures that the story they’re telling is supported by key insights.

Use GenAI to create dynamic, interactive presentations with simple prompts.

2. Dynamic, Always Up-to-Date Presentations
: Dataiku Stories allows for presentations that update automatically with new data. This means teams no longer need to create new decks every reporting cycle; instead, they can create once and reuse, knowing the data is always fresh and reliable.

3. Collaboration Workspaces
: Analysts and business stakeholders can work together through collaboration features within Dataiku Stories as well as in shared workspaces. This enables collaborative storytelling, with features like tags and shared data views, ensuring everyone is aligned on the insights being presented.

Easily collaborate with business teams in Workspaces.

4. Seamless Data Integration
: Because Dataiku Stories is part of the broader Dataiku platform, presentations are built from trusted data. Analysts don’t need to worry about exporting data from one tool to another — it all happens within a single environment.

Use Cases: Dataiku Stories in Action

To better understand the value of Dataiku Stories, let’s look at a few real-world use cases:

Regular Business-Decision Supporting Reporting
: Teams responsible for regular reports — whether financial, marketing, or operational — can use Dataiku Stories to create reusable presentations. Since the data updates automatically, teams can save time by reusing their slides each cycle, leverage the Gen AI assistant to structure their insights, confident that the latest data is being pulled into the presentation.

On-the-Fly Presentations
: In fast-moving operational meetings, where key decisions need to be made quickly, Dataiku Stories allows teams to create slides on the fly. With data being pulled in real-time, there’s no need to wait for manual updates or worry about outdated information.

From AI Project to Insights
: Imagine a machine learning team has developed a customer propensity model. Before moving it into production, they need to present the model’s outcome to the business. With Dataiku Stories, they can quickly generate a business-focused presentation using Gen AI, leveraging trusted data directly from their project. The presentation can then be refined, with stakeholders
collaborating
in real-time. And because the story is dynamic, any updates to the model or underlying data are automatically reflected in the presentation.

Conclusion: Elevating Data Insights With Dataiku Stories

Dataiku Stories is a game-changer for analytics and data teams looking to enhance the way they deliver insights. With dynamic, trusted presentations built in seconds and enhanced by Generative AI, the feature bridges the gap between
data preparation
and data storytelling. Whether for AI project reviews, repetitive reports, or quick operational updates, Dataiku Stories ensures that your presentations are as agile as the data behind them. It’s time to say goodbye to static slides and hello to dynamic, trustworthy insights that drive real business outcomes.

Dataiku Stories is currently available to qualified existing customers.

Davivienda: Redefining Customer Engagement With Predictive Life Event Models

Mar 5, 2025

2 min read

/

Renata Halim

Davivienda
is elevating customer engagement by anticipating key life events and delivering personalized financial solutions at the right moment. To better serve its 21 million customers, the bank moved beyond reactive offers to proactively predict significant life moments — such as family planning, real estate purchases, and health-related events. This approach aims to provide timely, tailored financial solutions that enhance customer satisfaction, drive engagement, and foster long-term loyalty.

Overcoming Data Challenges to Predict Life Events

Understanding customers’ evolving needs required a solution capable of analyzing large and complex datasets. Davivienda collected extensive information on customer spending habits, savings, loans, and credit activity. However, consolidating and analyzing this data to identify patterns and predict life events proved challenging. The bank also needed a solution that could handle the scale of its 21 million customers while improving efficiency and ensuring compliance.

Developing Predictive Models Powered by Dataiku

To address this challenge, Davivienda turned to
Dataiku
— the Universal AI Platform — to build a predictive solution that transformed its approach to customer engagement. Using the Dataiku platform, the bank created a
full data pipeline
that managed everything from data integration to model deployment.

The team developed over 400 behavioral variables that captured customer spending and financial activity, pulling data from payment tables, savings, loans, and credit bureau records. These variables were used to create predictive models that analyzed customer behavior and identified the likelihood of key life events, such as health-related expenses or family planning.

Automation
played a crucial role in the solution. Dataiku streamlined workflows, significantly reducing the time needed for data preparation, modeling, and reporting. The integration with
Google Cloud Platform
ensured that the solution remained agile and scalable for the bank’s large customer base. Collaboration among teams, including marketing intelligence, analytics, and the Chief Data Office, ensured the model adhered to compliance standards and aligned with business goals.

One huge win with Dataiku was the time savings — it really sped up the whole process. Thanks to its streamlined workflows and automation, we could process and analyze data way faster than with other methods.

- Juan de la Calle, Head of Customer Analytics Models at Davivienda

Dataiku’s easy-to-use interface, along with its automation and control features, let us build a scalable solution that predicts important life events.

- Juan de la Calle, Head of Customer Analytics Models at Davivienda

Delivering Personalized Offers and Improved Efficiency

The predictive model transformed Davivienda’s customer engagement strategy. By anticipating life events, the bank delivered personalized offers and financial solutions tailored to individual needs. This approach increased customer engagement, improved conversion rates, and strengthened relationships.

Operationally, the solution reduced the time required to process and analyze data, enabling faster campaign launches. Teams became more efficient, shifting their focus from manual processes to strategic decision-making. The model’s scalability ensured it worked seamlessly for all 21 million customers, further enhancing the bank’s ability to connect with its audience.

In terms of metrics, the time saved in processing and analyzing data thanks to Dataiku’s automation has been a major win. The marketing intelligence team has become more efficient, with a significant reduction in the time required to launch campaigns, and the accuracy of our targeting has greatly improved.

- Juan de la Calle, Head of Customer Analytics Models at Davivienda

Expanding Predictive Modeling to Drive Future Innovation

Davivienda’s success with predictive life event modeling has transformed its ability to deliver personalized financial solutions. By proactively addressing key customer needs, the bank achieved higher engagement rates, improved conversion metrics, and strengthened customer relationships. The solution’s scalability and operational efficiency have also streamlined marketing campaigns, saving significant time and resources. With Dataiku and its integration with Google Cloud Platform, Davivienda remains well-positioned to drive innovation and deliver exceptional value to its 21 million customers.

Davivienda: Transforming Customer Engagement Through Data Accuracy

Mar 5, 2025

2 min read

/

Renata Halim

As one of Colombia’s most innovative banks,
Davivienda
drives digital transformation to better serve its 21 million customers. Accurate and reliable contact information is crucial for delivering exceptional service, running effective marketing campaigns, and sending timely notifications. But inconsistent phone number data from multiple sources made it difficult to engage customers effectively, limiting opportunities for communication and creating inefficiencies across teams.

The Challenge: Resolving Inconsistent Customer Contact Data

Davivienda collected phone numbers from various sources, including credit bureaus, marketing campaigns, and internal databases. These sources often provided conflicting or outdated information for the same customer, leading to confusion and unreliable outreach. Without accurate phone numbers, marketing campaigns, customer service efforts, and important notifications suffered, resulting in missed opportunities to engage customers.

Manually sorting through these data sources consumed valuable time and often failed to deliver accurate results. Davivienda needed a scalable solution to consolidate phone number data, assess its reliability, and identify the most accurate number for each customer.

The Solution: Building a Scalable Model With Dataiku

Davivienda used
Dataiku
— the Universal AI Platform — to create a model that calculates the probability of each phone number being accurate for a customer. The platform enabled the bank to seamlessly integrate and process data from multiple sources, creating a unified view of customer contact information.

The model considered factors such as the frequency of a phone number’s appearance across sources, the recency of the data, and the customer’s interaction history. By automating the pipeline — from data preparation to model deployment — Dataiku allowed Davivienda to efficiently handle the phone number validation process for 21 million customers.

By implementing the model in Dataiku, we have been able to increase the accuracy of our customer contact information, which has improved several key areas of our business. One of the biggest impacts has been in our marketing campaigns and customer service, where the contact success rate increased by 13%. This means we can reach more customers with the right offers and information at the right time, improving engagement and satisfaction.

- Juan de la Calle, Head of Customer Analytics Models at Davivienda

Teams across the organization collaborated to ensure the model’s success. Data scientists and analysts built and refined the model, while the Chief Data Office ensured compliance and accuracy.
This collaborative approach, supported by Dataiku’s flexibility, improved the accuracy of customer contact information by 13%
.

With Dataiku, we can build and deploy models faster, and the automation has saved us countless hours. Additionally, the transparency and governance features in Dataiku have been very helpful, making it easier for the Chief Data Office to review and approve models, ensuring compliance.

- Juan de la Calle, Head of Customer Analytics Models at Davivienda

The Impact: Enhanced Operations and Customer Engagement

The implementation of this solution significantly improved Davivienda’s ability to connect with customers:

Marketing campaigns achieved a 13% increase in contact success rates, enabling the delivery of timely and relevant offers.

The collections team improved efficiency by reaching customers faster and resolving overdue accounts more effectively.

Automation reduced manual workloads, allowing teams to focus on strategic initiatives instead of data reconciliation.

These improvements strengthened customer relationships and enhanced the overall effectiveness of Davivienda’s operations.

A Vision for Data-Driven Customer Excellence

This initiative represents a key milestone in Davivienda’s commitment to innovation and customer-centric operations. With Dataiku, the bank built a scalable solution that not only resolved a critical challenge but also laid the foundation for future advancements in customer engagement.

By ensuring accurate contact information and streamlining outreach, Davivienda continues to strengthen its relationships with customers while driving operational efficiency and sustainable growth.

DeepSeek's Rise Shows Why AI Flexibility Matters More Than Ever

Dec 29, 2024

4 min read

/

Nanette George

The generative AI (GenAI) landscape shifted dramatically this month when DeepSeek, a startup based in China, made headlines with two significant moves: releasing its AI assistant as a free app that quickly became the number one download on Apple's App Store and open-sourcing its DeepSeek R1 model.

The news about DeepSeek’s free GenAI application sent shockwaves through financial markets, and tech giants like NVIDIA and Microsoft saw their stock values decline on Monday. Why? DeepSeek claims it developed its model for under $6 million — a fraction of the investments reportedly made by U.S. companies like Anthropic and OpenAI. Dataiku’s CEO
Florian Douetteau shared his take on this news
in Fortune.

Market Context and Privacy Concerns

While DeepSeek's free app is the number one download on the Apple App Store charts, its privacy policy reveals a significant concern: All user data, including prompts, uploaded files, and chat history, is
stored on servers in China
and may be shared with Chinese authorities. This presents serious risks for organizations whose employees might be tempted to use the free app for work-related tasks like strategy development, content creation, writing code, or document processing.

Organizations seeking to implement GenAI have two options. They can use open source models like DeepSeek R1 and manage their own infrastructure, costs, and risk mitigation. Or, they can implement a comprehensive proprietary solution.

A Broader Signal

DeepSeek's emergence signals more than just another competitor entering the market — it demonstrates how rapidly the AI landscape is changing. A few notable trends underpin GenAI’s rapid transformations:

Model proliferation and power:
New and more capable models are emerging at an accelerating pace. What seemed like cutting-edge performance six months ago becomes baseline capability today as researchers and companies worldwide push the boundaries of what's possible with AI.

Cost considerations:
Training and inference costs are critical to the development of GenAI. If their claim is true, DeepSeek's achievement in building a performant model for $6 million challenges the assumption that state-of-the-art AI requires massive investment. It also represents a notable achievement for AI builders. This cost reduction democratizes AI development and opens new possibilities for innovation.

Open source momentum:
The open source AI movement is gaining unprecedented traction. Models that rival proprietary solutions in capability are freely available, spurring innovation and enabling organizations to build sophisticated AI applications without vendor lock-in.

Geographic diversification:
Innovation is emerging from unexpected places, demonstrating that breakthrough AI developments can come from anywhere. This global distribution of AI innovation creates new opportunities and considerations for organizations building AI solutions.

5 Reasons Why Optionality Matters Now More Than Ever

The DeepSeek story illustrates a fundamental truth about AI development: The only constant is change. For organizations building AI solutions, it is imperative to maintain flexibility in their AI infrastructure. Here's how organizations benefit from
optionality in their AI technology stack
:

Evolution of AI capabilities:
Today's breakthrough model could be tomorrow's baseline technology. Organizations need the ability to adopt new models and capabilities as they emerge without rebuilding their entire AI infrastructure. This flexibility ensures that investments made today continue to deliver value as technology evolves

Cost optimization opportunities:
As training and inference costs evolve, organizations should be positioned to use more cost-effective solutions. The
ability to switch between models and providers
allows companies to optimize their AI spending while maintaining or improving performance.

Infrastructure adaptation:
Different AI models have different infrastructure requirements. Some may run effectively on existing hardware, while others might require specialized computing resources. A flexible approach allows organizations to leverage their existing infrastructure while selectively adopting new tools as needed.

Risk and cost mitigation through diversification:
Model availability and performance can change unexpectedly, as can costs. With a flexible platform, organizations can maintain multiple model options for critical applications and quickly adapt to changes in model availability or pricing. According to the Dataiku 2025 Trends Report, the vast
majority of organizations are using multiple LLMs
. As costs change, flexibility allows organizations to select the most cost-effective options for different use cases and base resource scaling on actual usage patterns.

Innovation through accessibility:
A flexible AI stack allows organizations to innovate faster because they can experiment with new models without significant infrastructure changes and rapidly prototype new applications.

Building a Future-Proof AI Foundation With the Dataiku LLM Mesh

The
Dataiku LLM Mesh
addresses these challenges through a tool-agnostic approach that provides crucial flexibility in several key areas:

Infrastructure integration:
Organizations can leverage their existing technology investments while maintaining the freedom to adopt new tools. This means organizations can:

Continue using current data storage and processing systems

Integrate new AI models as they become available

Scale resources based on actual needs

Maintain compatibility with evolving infrastructure standards

Tool selection freedom:
The ability to choose and change tools as needed is built into the platform's architecture. This enables organizations to:

Select the most appropriate AI models for specific use cases, including open source models from Hugging Face, OpenAI, and Anthropic

Switch between different providers without disrupting applications

Incorporate new capabilities as they emerge

Maintain optimal performance while controlling costs

Comprehensive cost analytics:
Dataiku's
LLM Cost Guard
provides comprehensive monitoring and optimization capabilities. This capability allows organizations to:

Track usage patterns by use case, user, or project

Calculate costs based on current market rates

Compare service effectiveness for different applications

Cache responses to routine queries to avoid the need to regenerate responses, which saves costs and boosts performance

The Bottom Line

DeepSeek's dramatic entrance into the AI market illustrates a crucial lesson: The AI landscape will continue to evolve in unexpected ways, bringing both opportunities and challenges. Organizations that build flexibility into their AI strategy today will be better positioned to capitalize on tomorrow's innovations, whether they come from established tech giants or emerging players.

The key to success lies not in betting on a single model or provider but in building an AI foundation that can adapt as the technology evolves. With tools like the Dataiku LLM Mesh, organizations can maintain the optionality they need to take advantage of new models, manage costs effectively, and scale their AI initiatives sustainably. This approach ensures that investments made in AI today will continue to deliver value as the technology landscape transforms.
